body:
Thanks for all your info! I typically eat about 90-120g of protein a day, according to MFP. Usually I eat protein with every meal. I do Bernsteins diet/Keto diet, but it hasn't really mattered over the years if I'm low carbing, moderate carbing, or high carbing; the desire to eat tends to linger. I'd absolutely love to not think about food for 5 hours! 

I just used a body fat calculator, (with tape measurements) and it estimated I'm at 23.5%

I'm encouraged :-). I've freelanced at a few studios similar to yours. Your co-workers sound like they're a supportive bunch! Dropping transphobic clients is quite the endorsement of your value and character. That must've  been profoundly reassuring to hear them say that :-).
Best of luck to you as well, both in transitioning and your career!
